issue.title: test-command-mode-runner budgets case fails against the wall clock under suite load
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-o6.5 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-o6 land agent. The case times read and writer budgets against the wall clock, so heavy parallel suite load blows the deadline. Suggested remediation: gate the lifecycle on fake-bob events instead of elapsed time, as bob-cli-dd.2 did for the FIFO test in this same file.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in a full npm test on athena at load average ~60 during the bob-cli-o6.5 gates (2026-11-20; 4.8 s observed where the budget expects less). Passed 2/2 alone on that tree and 1/1 on a clean c5f5a1b worktree — load-only, serial passes.
task_type_fields.node_id: scripts/test-command-mode-runner.cjs::read budgets kill; writer budgets mark overdue; stop stops
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: npm test in bob-plugins on athena under load (load average ~60)

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-o6.5 note #2 recorded this wall-clock flake with no bead tracking it (bob-cli-d9 and bob-cli-dd.2 fixed the FIFO/parallel-read race in the same file, a different test); filed by the bob-cli-o6 land agent.
